auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

about.description: Hardtech-BioMed is the HardTech area's human biology and medicine app, opened from the SuperApp's Cloud ▸ Lnktree row. Seven tabs, each a 3D scene: Physiology (the body systems), BioChem (circadian cycle, energy metabolism, detox, reproduction), BioMech (muscles and joints), Anatomy (the whole body), Genetic (a DNA helix), Neuro (a brain with every macro region) and Immuno (the immune system and the main pathology groups). The models are openly licensed (BodyParts3D, CC BY-SA 2.1 JP; the DNA model is generated and CC0) and, with the texts, are read at run time, not shipped inside the app. The texts are educational overviews in neutral wording, not medical advice.
features: Interactive 3D human body with a layer per body system
Every body system as a functional system
Circadian cycle, energy metabolism, detox and reproduction
3D brain with every macro region highlightable
Tap a part to name it

guide: Open a tab and wait for the model to appear (it is fetched once, then kept on the phone).
Turn the model with one finger, zoom with a pinch, tap a part to name it.
Pick a topic to light its parts and read about them.
Layers show or hide a body system.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. The app downloads its public 3D models and texts from the project's public repository; it sends nothing about you.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
